title: Singapore’s Abstention from Vote on International Labour Organization's Convention on Workplace Violence and Harassment
what_it_is: Singapore’s Abstention from Vote on International Labour Organization's Convention on Workplace Violence and Harassment

sections.label: ILO Convention 190 adoption
sections.summary: The ILO Convention on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work, Convention 190, was adopted at the International Labour Conference this year after two years of contentious negotiations.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The International Labour Organization (ILO) Convention on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work, also known as Convention 190, was adopted at the International Labour Conference this year after two years of contentious negotiations.

sections.label: Concerns about Convention overreach
sections.summary: On Convention 190, while we agree with its intent, there are concerns about overreach.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: On Convention 190, while we agree with its intent, there are concerns about overreach.

sections.label: ILO members' votes, Singapore abstention
sections.summary: One in three eligible ILO members voted against, abstained, or did not vote; Singapore abstained on the Convention but voted in favour of the accompanying ILO Recommendation.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Reflecting the significant concerns on a variety of issues, one in three of all eligible ILO members – which include governments, workers and employers – voted against the Convention, abstained, or did not vote.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: While Singapore voted to abstain for the Convention, we voted in favour of the non-legally binding ILO Recommendation accompanying the Convention, as it is aligned with our commitment to eliminate workplace violence and harassment.

sections.label: TAFEP complaints and workplace harassment
sections.summary: TAFEP receives a certain number of properly filed complaints each year, and a very small percentage concerns workplace harassment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: TAFEP receives a certain number of complaints each year that are properly filed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: A very small percentage has to do with workplace harassment.

sections.label: Singapore employers and employee representatives votes
sections.summary: Singapore employers voted against the Convention, while employee representatives, the National Trades Union Congress, voted in favour as a mark of solidarity.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Not surprisingly, when the matter was put to a vote, the employers in Singapore voted against it.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The employee representatives in Singapore, which refers to the National Trades Union Congress, voted to support in favour of the Convention as a mark of solidarity for the spirit behind it, knowing full well that the Government was going to vote to abstain from it.
